answer: Sybil resistance arises because coordinated equivocation across k identities triggers a quadratic penalty O(k^2), making collusion costlier than isolated faults. Bonded escrows are slashed collectively, while asymmetric capital depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to detected swarm control, rapidly eroding collateral. Thus an oasis, shale, or velvet-themed identity set gains no advantage from merely multiplying keys.
